name: ortho-japan
description: 日本の 3D 地図のサイト（www.ortho-earth.com/japan/）。SDK（@ortho-earth/japan）は sdk/japan に分けた（2026-10-15）。
author: Kenji Yoshida <kenji.yoshida.home.2026@gmail.com>

scripts.test: node demo/samples/test-scene-adapter.mjs && node tests/t-dtm.mjs && node tests/t-vocab.mjs && node tests/t-region.mjs && node tests/t-tier.mjs && node tests/t-pbrdecode.mjs && node tests/t-poioverrides.mjs && node tests/t-landmarks.mjs && node tests/t-meshq.mjs && node tests/t-fireworks.mjs && node tests/t-terrain.mjs && node tests/t-onsen.mjs && node tests/t-pointcloud.mjs && node tests/t-deploy.mjs
scripts.build:prod: npm run build -w @ortho-earth/japan && vite build && cp -R ../../sdk/japan/dist/lib dist/site/japan/lib && find dist/site/japan/lib -name '*.map' -delete
scripts.verify:japan: npm run verify:ui && npm run verify:webgpu
scripts.preview:prod: npm run build:prod && rm -rf dist/site/japan/moj-local && wrangler dev
